current_metadata.name: playwright-server-lifecycle
current_metadata.description: Use when Playwright or browser automation needs a local listener, temporary HTTP server, static viewer, dev or preview server, or Windows/PowerShell/OpenCode work shows hangs, zombies, unclear process ownership, cleanup failures, or missing callbacks.

generalized_description: Use when an agent-started or inherited local OS process may outlive its initiating tool call and lacks a verified complete lifecycle owner, including listeners, GUIs, watchers, detached finite jobs, and residual wrappers; classify external, framework-, IDE-, or runtime-managed resources and hand them off rather than managing their PIDs.
